title: Generic supplied data for coefficient arrow transport
statement: Let l be prime, Y a scheme, I and Q commutative condensed ring objects and a:Z_l->I, b:I->Q specified unital coefficient maps. Let L and M be the specified line families with underlying sheaf maps from zlLine to L and from L to M. CoefficientArrowRoute groups the three Diagram objects and their two normalized ScalarCompatibility structures [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-category, def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-scalars]. Separately, for commutative ordinary rings R,A, a ring homomorphism phi:R->A, a natural killing exponent N with N=0 in R and A, and Y a scheme, CartierScalarMaps groups the constant map on P=ProjectiveLine Y and the positive Tate-line map on W=diagonalSurface Y, together with exactly the constant-generator and pure-root-tensor normalizations appearing in GeoCartierScalarCompatibility [def-sfb-geo-cartier-interface]. Neither structure contains a Cartier class equation, a completion assertion, or an existence choice. CartierScalarMaps.Equation explicitly names the Yoneda square for two supplied classes, without asserting it. They group supplied data so that statements can use their shared types without repeatedly expanding concrete coefficient constructions.
